zh-Hant.title: 怪物旅館：午夜入住
zh-Hant.shortDescription: 破解可愛住客謎題，用金幣擴建屬於你的怪物旅館。
zh-Hant.fullDescription:
歡迎來到怪物旅館！認識可愛的原創怪物住客，挑戰配房、道路滑塊、幽靈洗衣房、找不同、影子與枕頭反彈等不同謎題。

完成解謎賺取金幣，購買裝飾，或在全新的酒店全景永久解鎖書室、觀星室、音樂室及烘焙房。看住客在旅館走動，點選他們打招呼，亦可返回原有四房旅館細看日常生活。

支援繁體中文與英文、離線遊玩及本機存檔。測試版本沒有真實廣告或追蹤 SDK。

試玩偵探案件：搜查四房、問住客、驗證機關並用證物指出矛盾，重組午夜經過。

en-US.title: Monster Hotel: Midnight Inn
en-US.shortDescription: Solve charming monster puzzles and grow your own cosy hotel.
en-US.fullDescription:
Welcome to Monster Hotel! Meet original, charming monster guests and solve room assignments, sliding roads, ghost laundry, picture differences, shadow puzzles and pillow-bounce challenges.

Earn coins from puzzles, choose decorations and permanently open a woodland library, observatory, music room and honey bakery in the Whole Hotel view. Watch residents wander, tap to greet them, or return to the original four-room hotel.

Play offline in English or Traditional Chinese, with progress saved on your device. This test version contains no live advertising or tracking SDK.

Try an original detective case: inspect rooms, question guests, test a mechanism and challenge a contradiction before reconstructing the night.
